name: flow_results_counts_standing_forks
description: The results' Towers column counts what stands at the end, as design 5.8 draws it ('9 (4 forked)': the towers standing and how many of them stand forked). It counted every fork ever made, a sold tower's too (playtest halv s2, P10, f45152: '9 (18 forked)' after the Lamplighter sold and forked her Skyward Lofts into Longbows all match). Here three Arrow Towers, two forked, the forked one at (6, 3) sold: two stand, one of them forked, so the row says '2 (1 forked)' while the seat has made 2 forks. Without the fix it said '2 (2 forked)'.

steps.assert: scene.build('arrow', Vector2i(6, 3)) and scene.build('arrow', Vector2i(8, 3)) and scene.build('arrow', Vector2i(5, 3))

steps.msg: two forked, a Longbow and a Skyward Loft

steps.assert: scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3)) == null and Game.sim.seat(1).towers == 2 and Game.sim.seat(1).forks == 2
steps.msg: the forked Longbow sold: two stand, and the seat has made two forks
two towers stand, one of them forked
the row's Towers cell says 2 (1 forked), not the forks ever made
